<b>Pondcatcher Reed</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They provide information on [[Bellhart]] and [[Shellwood]].

== Background ==
<b>Pondcatcher Reed</b> is a Bellhart resident and the last [[Pondcatcher]] that has not fallen to the [[Haunting]].<ref>Pondcatcher Reed: <i>"I'm a pondcatcher around these parts. The last remaining, in fact!"</i></ref> They venture out into Shellwood to hunt food for the other Bellhart residents.<ref>{{HTalk|"Are you a hunter, of a sort?"}}<br>Pondcatcher Reed: <i>"Of a simple sort, aye ... Us few Bellharters are badly needing for fresh food, so my lone shell's carrying quite the responsibility."</i></ref>

Pondcatcher Reed can be found either wandering the streets of Bellhart, or making their way to or from Shellwood.

== In-game Events ==
When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] first arrives in Bellhart, Pondcatcher Reed is seen suspended in the air by silk threads, alongside several other residents. After [[Widow]] is defeated, Pondcatcher Reed is freed and becomes an NPC in town.

== Location ==
After [[Widow]] is defeated, Pondcatcher Reed can occasionally be seen in [[Bellhart]]. They can also occasionally be found in [[Shellwood]], travelling to and from Bellhart's western entrance.

After reaching Act 3, Pondcatcher Reed will no longer appear.

==Creation and Development==
{{Main|Cut Content (Silksong)/NPCs#Pondcatcher Reed}}
Despite being a minor character in the final release build of <i>Silksong</i>, Pondcatcher Reed went through numerous reworks throughout development. When first seen in the February 2019 <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer, they wore a grey cloak and had no nostrils, and another screenshot released by ''IGN'' in May 2025 showcases them wearing a brown cloak. Pondcatcher Reed also was planned to appear to the left of the bench in Bellhart in [[Act 3]], but this appearance was removed. They also have numerous cut animations with the internal label of <code>in_house</code>, implying that they had a house earlier in development.
